STIPULATION TO ALLOW MATTER TO BE HEARD BEFORE A JUDGE PRO TEM. FILED BY SMITS, MARK JOYA, PAOLA TOVAR UDR,INC
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY SMITS, MARK JOYA, PAOLA TOVAR AS TO DEFENDANT UDR,INC ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-24-2023 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) MARK LEGASPI, COMMUNITY DIRECTOR FILED BY DEFENDANT UDR,INC
ORDER TO CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT: PENDING SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-24-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO MAY-24-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF MARK SMITS IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF PAOLA TOVAR JOYA IS PRESENT VIA UNAUTHORIZED ZOOM APPEARANCE. DEFENDANT UDR, INC. IS PRESENT REPRESENTED BY MAURICE LEGASPI, COMMUNITY DIRECTOR. ALL PARTIESS AND THE JUDGE PRO TEM ALLOW THE PLAINTIFF TOVAR JOYA TO APEAR VIA ZOOM. PLAINTIFF SMITS HAS EXHIBITS FOR BOTH CO-PLAINTIFFS. PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR A PAYMENT OF $2152.50 TO THE PLAINTIFFS. APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED AT THE MAY-24-2023 HEARING IF NO PAYMENT IS MADE, AND JUDGMENT WILL BE ENTERED FOR THE PLAINTIFFS. IF NO APPEARANCES THE CASE WILL BE DISMISSED WITH PREJUDICE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-24-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SMITS, MARK JOYA, PAOLA TOVAR RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT UDR,INC $2,152.50 PRINCIPAL, $100.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,252.50 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
